title: GPT Image keeps transparent backgrounds
summary:
GPT Image gained transparent PNGs and shared in-flight generations, while settings gained an ad preference control and image safety checks expanded.

GPT Image results now retain PNG output instead of being converted to JPEG, preserving transparent backgrounds even when a logo is composited. Simultaneous image requests with the same prompt and parameters now share one generation, while failed generations can be retried.

Authenticated users can now view and change their Show Ads preference in settings. The update preserves explicit choices, fixes bearer-token access to preferences, and removes an unused events component and YouTube links from the site.

GPT Image prompt moderation now uses Azure Content Safety, and image-editing requests also check fetched input images. Image fetching and processing errors are reported more specifically.
